state.seed_assertion: When determining whether the processing is carried out on a large scale, the number of data subjects involved should be considered, either as a specific number or as a percentage of the relevant population.

sentences.1: When determining whether the processing is carried out on a large scale, the number of data subjects involved should be considered, either as a specific number or as a percentage of the relevant population.
sentences.3: the number of data subjects involved, either as a specific number or as a percentage of the relevant population;
sentences.4: Data processed on a large scale is a criterion triggering DPIA requirements, determined by considering the number of data subjects, volume and range of data items, duration of processing, and geographical extent.
sentences.5: Data processed on a large scale taking into account the following factors, when determining whether the processing is carried out on a large scale: the number of data subjects concerned, either as a specific number or as a proportion of the relevant population, the volume and/or the range of different data items being processed, the duration or permanence of the data processing activity and the geographical extent of the process ing activity
sentences.6: You need to be confident that you can demonstrate that the nature, scope, context and purposes of the processing are all similar when relying on a previously completed substantially similar DPIA.
